question: At the same supported ambiguity and same six-extra-task allowance, does candidate-intervention practice differ from six sequential ordinary training tasks with all learned R+L retained?
source_rule: One fresh state per mode installs both kappa sources at once: WAIT at specified cell for t>=prefix through11, m0,1,z1,phi2; DQ6 or independent literalD WAIT. One phase4 unread wrong-RIGHT sentinel at(1,2,t1,kappa0,z1,m0) plus unread process3->2. Equal full initialR+L cloned independently to four arms; no state resets between tasks.
episode_inputs: Chronological main e0..17, kappa from shared schedule,phi2/errorflag0/rank10/base1, sharedMAX coins. Trap(1,2,step0) only e4,5,7. Supplement branches repeat CURRENT task conditions, not future stream conditions.
model: Same frozen28row value model. Neither arm retrains it. Practice uses event outcomes to choose an edit; ExtraTD retains all6ordinary updates in a separate declared dataflow. All roles retain main ordinary learning, success zero diagnostics.
diagnostic: Enabled after every actual COLLISION/TRAP/TIMEOUT for corrected arms, not only first task. SUCCESS ordinary-only. Max12addresses and0queries per event; individual consumed epochs, completeR+L and immediateI persist. TaskTD never diagnoses. Keep allowed.
retention_protocol: At each checkpoint ordinary greedy read-only rollouts in kappa0 and1, phi2/rank8/base1/no-fault. No coins, TD, diagnosis, writes or new source identity. Full before/after R+L+I identical; native counts separately. These are outcome checks, not success attribution. They are not training episodes or independent seeds.
metrics: All18 chronological main task returns/successes, all supplements costs, current-state carry/adoption, and6checkpoint clean read-only banks. No posthoc best window/weightedutility or invented overall equivalence.
capture: New exclusive bounded capture and source pins before first execution. Old code/positive/negative/partial results unchanged, no old checker/native rerun, no automatic retry or replacing adverse/unknown outcomes.
limits: Fixed scripted stream, not blind population/seeds/general causal posterior. Same sharedQ*, alpha1/2 epsilon1/10 and original rewards. Legal local edits on post-TD current, not original same-pre wholeB1. Trap phases are deliberate environmental changes; compare same-schedule arms, do not label changing-environment return as general collateral. No new science/workload keys, RNG/keyderive, DP/calibration/formal collection. Automation off, not inspected or changed. This is a new action-intervention practice capability in the revised V04 experiment, not an assertion that v122 already had it. Only the tested aliased candidates are adjudicated; no total compute matching or universal attribution claim. Additional experiment after local-stage closure; v124 remains a historical scoped completion, not withdrawn or rewritten. Rollout-count matching is weaker than exact compute matching; not a pure representation ablation, population inference or full causal pipeline.

practice.trigger: PracticeValue only, actual failed task after ordinary learning, chosen single-address has at least2 top-scored single candidates with identical feature key. No truth/location label, future schedule or environment configuration is passed to request/choice policy.
practice.cap: At most ONE supplemental event per role. PracticeValue: keep+first2aliased top singles,2ordinarytasks/branch=6tasks. EvidenceExtraTD: no candidate edit at event,6sequentialordinarytasks in ONE live fullR+L clone, then retain all final R+L, no choosing best checkpoint. Both require the same actual visible ambiguity trigger.
practice.execution: Runner-private current-task environment capability binds current observed kappa/phase and current actual mask, never future masks. Clone actual complete live post-TD R+L into separate branches; candidate edits on branch,2repeat-current-condition tasks, no diagnostics inside branches. Origin and its I stay unchanged. New typed data/branches, not restored issuedB1handles.
practice.decision: Choose greatest actual two-task mean from keep and tested singles; exact ties prefer fewer attempted address edits then declared order. Apply chosen original proposal once to live post-TD state. Scores remain frozen; practice outcomes are ephemeral event evidence.
practice.cost: All branch rollouts/steps/ordinary transactions and candidate writes counted separately; task and retention comparison shares task schedule but NOT total compute. No net efficiency or full-menu optimality claim. Standard query API remains0; these new practice operations are not claimed free or nonexistent.

extra_ordinary: At ambiguity EvidenceExtraTD returns keep to existing diagnostic executor. AFTER that main task completes, a new explicit runner operation consumes6ordinary episodes in a fresh live post-TD R+L clone with no diagnosis; it adopts the complete actual learned R+L into that same main learner, preserves original I/stream clock, and records both clocks. Not an old B1 receipt, fake Proposal, monkeypatch or serialized handle. No ordinary learning owner filter. Supplement data always retained regardless of outcomes.
comparison: Match extra rollout allowance and, if achieved, actual rollout counts. Task horizon12each gives same upper action allowance; actual steps/transactions/clones/IO/time may differ and must be reported. Root full R+L+I at first event compared, no claim of exact total compute matching.
